name: excel_new_sheet
description: Open Excel, create a new sheet, fill given cells, optionally add a SUM formula.
prompt: Open Excel and create a new blank workbook. Flow: Win+R → 'excel' → Enter and pick a blank workbook. Starting from cell A1, enter these headers (comma separated): {{headers}}. Fill rows using this format (each row is comma separated, rows are separated by '||'): {{rows}}. If a formula cell is requested, write it: {{formula_cell}} = {{formula}}. Use Ctrl+T to convert the range to a table when helpful. Title: {{title}}. If save_path is non-empty, save the workbook there: {{save_path}} (File → Save As → file_dialog_paste). Skip any step whose placeholder is empty.
